commitments.detail: Implement a six-month monitoring period to ensure compliance with new policies.
Company will be monitored for 6 months following submission of the assurance-of-voluntary-compliance filing.
Insurer must provide consent before any refunds can be issued as part of the remediation program.
No immediate refunds; instead, a monitoring period of 6 months will be implemented.
Cancellation anytime clause will be included in all contracts.
Renewal notices will be provided 30 days in advance.
The company will be monitored for 6 months following the implementation of the remediation program.
The insurer's consent is required before any refunds are issued to customers.
